title: R63 early B-channel H1 2x2 gate-condition versus direct-collective injection localization and structural transfer
definition: H1: base or nonflat B aggregation used independently to evaluate invariant-dependent 8 HCA gates and direct collective-vector injection. All other computations and H2-H20 transport are baseline. Interventions are diagnostic; not physically proposed for deployment.
limitations: Frozen R52 weights; no prospective learned utility
8 new synthetic evaluation seeds but historical graph family and artificial B transport seam
Surgical gate injection and vector injection paths are counterfactual, not physical modules
No native GDN, no independent AWR bank, no inference NAND writes
